name: I Hope He Buys You Flowers Trend: Pull a Flower Out of Your Nose
blurb: The I Hope He Buys You Flowers trend, also called the flower in nose trend, is a TikTok joke from May 2026: you pull a whole small flower out of your nose and hand it to the camera while Bruno Mars sings "I hope he buys you flowers".

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 11 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same green park with tall leafy trees in soft daylight, the same handheld front-camera selfie video, the same framing, timing, hand moves and face moves. The ONLY change: the young man with short messy brown hair in the dark zip hoodie in [Video 1] is now the person in [Image 1].

[Video 1] is a one-take close-up phone video to copy: copy its movement, its camera and its timing exactly. The young man in [Video 1] is a different person: he sets ONLY the pose and the movement, never the face, hair, skin tone or age. The person from [Image 1] is in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The person wears the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also in the big close-up and while they squint and grin. Never morph, never drift back to the original young man's face, never add or remove facial hair. NO short messy brown hair, NO dark zip hoodie and NO chain necklace unless [Image 1] shows them.

BEAT BY BEAT: copy [Video 1] exactly:
[00:00-00:01.5] MOVING FROM THE VERY FIRST FRAME: the handheld phone camera at arm's length, chest up; the person smiles at the camera and points at their own nose with one finger.
[00:01.5-00:03] the camera swings in to a big close-up of the face, looking slightly up; eyebrows up, a puzzled look, as if something is wrong with the nose.
[00:03-00:05.5] the hand comes up and the fingers pinch at ONE NOSTRIL, the eyes squint and wince; the short bright green flower stem shows in that nostril (never from the mouth).
[00:05.5-00:06.5] the fingers pull the stem out of the nostril and a small white daisy with a yellow centre comes out of the nose.
[00:06.5-00:11] the person holds the white daisy up beside their face toward the camera, offering it, with a big proud grin into the lens.

ONE continuous vertical 9:16 shot, no cuts, the same green park and soft daylight throughout. Keep the person's face sharp and clearly lit.

Real live-action footage, clear facial features, no distortion, no deformation, the same character.

No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Avoid: a frozen or still opening, a static camera, the young man from [Video 1], a different person, the stem in the mouth, extra hands, extra fingers, extra flowers, captions, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, extra cuts, morphing, distortion.

Anatomy rules: one head only. One hand near the face, five fingers. Exactly one person in the frame. One small daisy on one stem, never part of the face.

The dog in [Video 1] is a different animal: it sets ONLY the pose and the movement, never the face, fur, colour, ears or breed. The pet from [Image 1] is in EVERY frame, exactly as in [Image 1]: the same species, breed, face, fur colour, markings, eyes and ears, a real animal with natural anatomy and its own furry paws, never human hands, and no person anywhere in the shot.

The pet = the pet in [Image 1]: the same species and breed, face, eyes, ears, muzzle, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything. Whether [Image 1] shows a dog, a cat or another animal, it stays that animal. The same pet in every frame, from the first second to the last, so its owner instantly recognizes it. Never drift back to the dog in the video: not the coat or the face of the dog in the video unless [Image 1] shows them. The pet wears the pink flower crown from [Video 1], sized to its own head, between its own ears.

[00:01.5-00:05.5] it lifts one front paw up toward its nose, the fluffy paw big and close to the lens, pawing at the stem; the stem stays in its nostril.
[00:05.5-00:07] the paw pulls the stem out of the nostril and a small white daisy with a yellow centre comes out of its nose.
[00:07-00:08] the pet holds the white daisy up in front of its face toward the camera, offering it, looking sweetly into the lens.

ONE continuous vertical 9:16 shot, no cuts, the same sunny meadow and soft daylight throughout. Keep the pet's face sharp and clearly lit.

Real live-action footage, clear facial features, no distortion, no deformation, the same character.

No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
